name: leave_only
note: Drive to the LOADING ZONE and stay: LEAVE plus AUTO PARK, with no launching.

children.note: Every drive to PARK runs the intake: the robot faces the alliance wall, where NECTAR from the LOADING ZONE collects, and a full hopper at the end of AUTO is a head start in TELEOP. LEAVE needs the robot clear of the wall by half its size plus 2 cm. The pose is 9 cm off the wall, which leaves margin for a 5 cm drive tolerance.
